routeStatuses.title: Monday 23 - Tuesday 24 November
routeStatuses.detail:
**Monday 23 November**

Due to an operational issue with the sector light at Ardrossan being inoperable, service is liable to disruption or cancellation at short notice.

An update regarding repairs will be provided on Monday 23 November.

Due to forecast easterly winds, service from the 13:55 departing Brodick is a heightened risk of diversion to Troon.

There will be a review at 13:15 for service for the remainder of the day.

**Tuesday 24 November**

Due to forecast easterly winds, the 07:00 departing Ardrossan is liable to operate from Troon.

routeStatuses.title: A841 Road Closure
routeStatuses.detail: Following recent storms, there is a road closure on the A841 between Lochranza and Catacol until approximately 28 February 2027.  There is a significant diversion in place and we advise to plan accordingly for those travelling to/from Brodick.

routeStatuses.title: Winter timetable 2026/2027
routeStatuses.detail: The winter 2026/27 timetable for this route is now available to [view online](https://www.calmac.co.uk/en-gb/route-information/ardrossan-brodick/#timetables) and bookings are open.

routeStatuses.title: Subscriber texts
routeStatuses.detail: To subscribe to live updates for a particular route text the words CALMAC and SUBSCRIBE along with the route code of your choice to 60030 e.g. "CALMAC SUBSCRIBE 05". This will automatically subscribe you to ongoing service information relating to that route for a six month period.

routeStatuses.title: Information
routeStatuses.detail:
**CalMac Status app**

Our CalMac status app is available to download from your usual Google and Apple app stores. Once downloaded, you can sign up to receive push notifications on your favourite routes. You can also view the timetable files for the route and date you have selected.  **Please note, the results returned will not be a ‘live’ picture of services at that time**  – instead, they are an enhanced, easy to read excerpt of the timetable. Please continue to check service status for the most up to date information.

You can also sign up for subscriber texts for your favourite route. Click or tap if you trust this link.").

**Passenger rights**

If your sailing is disrupted or cancelled, [read our online guide](https://gbr01.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.calmac.co.uk%2Fen-gb%2Fbook%2Fpassenger-rights%2F%23%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cserviceupdates%40calmac.co.uk%7C337190d665654e0c34e008ddc2df15cb%7C6a0fcf52b56b4d06abd4b98cbb53c985%7C1%7C0%7C638880985578738480%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=nmOcl%2FS2Rj2tujtjPqTJSWOTb4SSOirShAABiJcHad4%3D&reserved=0 "Original URL: https://www.calmac.co.uk/en-gb/book/passenger-rights/#/. Click or tap if you trust this link.") to find out what you may be entitled to and how to claim.

**Turn Up and Go and Bookable route online purchases**. If you have purchased tickets online as a group or for any number of travel companions, for use on any of our [Turn Up and Go](https://www.calmac.co.uk/tickets/turn-up-and-go) or [Bookable routes](https://www.calmac.co.uk/faqs/tickets-and-reservations/bookable-routes), the full party must travel on the same sailing. This applies to both legs of your journey. If you are unsure if all members of your group are travelling together, please complete separate transactions online.

**Connecting Services**  For customers using [connecting services](https://www.calmac.co.uk/on-board/connecting-services) please note these services do not always guarantee a connection, particularly during times of disruption. We advise that you check both CalMac and connecting service websites prior to travel to ensure you can reach your end destination safely.

**Stay Safe**  
When travelling with us, we strongly recommend our customers follow our [safer travel guidance.](https://www.calmac.co.uk/travelling-with-calmac/travel-preparation/safety)  Before travel, take a moment to familiarise yourself with the details.

routeStatuses.title: Monday 23 - Tuesday 24 November
routeStatuses.detail:
Due to an adverse weather forecast this evening into Tuesday morning, the 18:10 departing Troon is **cancelled**.

**Tuesday 24 November**

As a result of the cancellation of the 18:10 sailing from Troon on Monday, the 07:30 departing Brodick on Tuesday 24 November is cancelled.

Due to adverse weather, service is liable to disruption or cancellation at short notice.

routeStatuses.title: MV Alfred Vehicle Customers
routeStatuses.detail:
MV Alfred can accommodate all types of vehicles, with the exception of motorhomes over 6 metres or any vehicle towing a caravan. If you are travelling in a motorhome of any size, please make your booking via our  [Customer Engagement Centre](https://www.calmac.co.uk/en-gb/contact-us/#/)  or port of departure. Any customers with a motorhome over 6 meters must travel on Ardrossan-Brodick or via our Claonaig-Lochranza service.

[View information on travelling via Claonaig-Lochranza.][1] 


  [1]: https://www.calmac.co.uk/faqs/before-you-travel/what-information-do-i-need-to-know-when-travelling-on-the-claonaig-lochranza-service/

routeStatuses.title: Winter timetable 2026/2027
routeStatuses.detail:
Following a review of vessel deployment, MV Alfred will operate services between Troon and Brodick from Monday 19 October to Monday 18 January inclusive.

[View the Troon – Brodick winter timetable operating Monday 19 October – Monday 18 January.](https://www.calmac.co.uk/route-information/troon-brodick/#timetables)

We are working on timetable and vessel deployment from Tuesday 19 January and will publish this as soon as possible.

routeStatuses.title: MV Alfred is currently operating on this route
routeStatuses.detail:
There is no hot meals service on onboard MV Alfred. However, there is a cold drinks/snacks vending machine located in the passenger lounge that accepts both cash and card.

Refreshments including hot drinks and snacks are available from Troon port. Cash and card payments are accepted.

routeStatuses.title: Car parking at Troon
routeStatuses.detail:
The owners of Troon port, Associated British Ports, operate the car park at the port. Please be advised that charges apply.

[Read our frequently asked questions on travel to/from Troon](https://www.calmac.co.uk/en-gb/faqs/before-you-travel/arran-service-operating-fromto-troon/)  for further details on car parking and other useful information about what to expect at the port.
